subject.title: feat(discord): opt-in Discord Activities widget support

question: After the authorization path is unified and real-client proof is added, should bundled Discord Activities expose these opt-in public OAuth and agent-authored HTML routes?
rationale: Whether OpenClaw should permanently own this public browser execution and OAuth surface is a security and product-boundary choice that tests cannot resolve.

options.title: Fix, prove, and retain
options.body: Preserve the bundled opt-in feature, require canonical guild/channel authorization, real-client diagnostics, dependency review, and explicit security approval before merge.

options.title: Move outside the bundled plugin
options.body: Keep core Discord transport smaller by requiring this capability to ship as a separately reviewed plugin or integration with the necessary public APIs.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Close or defer the PR if the permanent public route and agent-authored HTML boundary is not worth its operational and security cost.

recommendation.title: Fix, prove, and retain
recommendation.body: Preserve the bundled opt-in feature, require canonical guild/channel authorization, real-client diagnostics, dependency review, and explicit security approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied guards identify this person as openclaw-secops, and they are carrying the feature design and implementation.
